push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 9.0 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
A 9.0 against Bluecocks BC, BellyTb1. If I had a hat I'd tip it, then I'd buy a second hat just to tip that one too.

DID WELL
+ 89% passing on 27 attempts, up from your usual 74%. Tidier than my mama's guest bathroom.
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 20). Always available, always an option.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ A brace against Bluecocks BC. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. That's leadership you can't fake.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

Back-garden drill: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 7.9 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
A 7.9 against Bluecocks BC, tuxedo_slide. That's the good stuff, the kind you tell your dog about on the drive home.

DID WELL
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 0%). Timing like a grandfather clock.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 1 shot on target kicked in +0.1. Small hinges swing big doors.
+ Stack that 7.9 against every midfielder out there: top 25%.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (12 of 22). Quick one: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- Passes attempted: 22. That's a B. The A-students among midfielders are at 25+.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 6+ is something else.

Coach's drill: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Believe. And maybe stretch. - Coach Lasso

Good stuff, PhogsToffees. A 7.7 against Bluecocks BC. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.
